# Franklin Anyanwu (DevHubFusionX) — Comprehensive Technical & Business Dossier

## 1. Executive Summary
Franklin Anyanwu (operating as DevHubFusionX / Frank. Engineering Studio) is a Lead Full-Stack Software Engineer and Systems Architect based in Lagos, Nigeria, delivering production-grade systems globally. 
Over 5+ years of active development, he has delivered 20+ applications spanning enterprise SaaS, real-time logistics networks, consumer mobile applications, fintech checkout systems, and custom business automations.

## 2. Technical Stack Specifications
### Frontend Technologies
- **Frameworks:** Next.js 16 (App Router, Turbopack, React Server Components), React 19, TypeScript
- **State & Data Management:** React Hooks, Redux Toolkit, Context API, TanStack Query
- **Styling & UI:** Tailwind CSS v4, Framer Motion, Vanilla CSS, Responsive Micro-Interactions
- **Performance:** Next.js Incremental Static Regeneration (ISR), Code Splitting, Core Web Vitals optimization

### Backend & APIs
- **Runtimes & Frameworks:** Node.js, Express.js, Next.js API Routes, Serverless Functions
- **APIs & Protocols:** RESTful APIs, GraphQL, WebSockets (real-time events)
- **Authentication & Security:** JWT, Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), CSRF & CORS policies, SSL encryption

### Databases & Cloud Storage
- **Relational Databases:** PostgreSQL, MySQL, Supabase
- **NoSQL Databases:** MongoDB, Cloud Firestore
- **Caching & Key-Value:** Redis
- **Media & File Storage:** Cloudinary, AWS S3

### Third-Party Integrations & APIs
- **Payment Processing:** Paystack (Nigeria & West Africa), Flutterwave (Pan-African), Stripe (Global)
- **Geolocation & Maps:** Google Maps Platform (Directions, Geocoding, Distance Matrix, Maps JavaScript API)
- **Messaging & Alerts:** Twilio, Resend, EmailJS, Webhooks

### AI & Modern Systems
- **On-Device AI:** Transformers.js, WebAssembly execution, local IndexedDB vector storage
- **LLM Integrations:** OpenAI API, Google Gemini API, Anthropic Claude API, streaming chat completions

## 3. Shipped Projects & Case Studies
### Dara Express (Logistics & Package Tracking)
- **URL:** https://daraexpress.com
- **Role:** Lead Full-Stack Software Engineer
- **Challenge:** Traditional delivery workflows relied on manual tracking, leading to opaque logistics and frequent dispatch delays.
- **Solution:** Built a centralized, API-driven logistics tracking portal with automated invoice generation and cross-region dispatch synchronization.
- **Results:** 40% reduction in manual dispatch errors and customer booking friction.

### blynQe (Social & Dating Platform)
- **URL:** https://blynqe.online
- **Role:** Lead Full-Stack Software Engineer
- **Challenge:** Creating an intentional, calm digital connection platform that scales across mobile web without high latency.
- **Solution:** Engineered a mobile-first UI with Next.js, optimized caching, and intentional introductory matching algorithms.
- **Results:** Supported 500,000+ registered global users with 35% faster page transitions.

### Noteable (100% On-Device AI Workspace)
- **URL:** https://noteable-kappa.vercel.app
- **Role:** Creator & Systems Architect
- **Challenge:** Modern AI note-taking applications upload private user data to third-party cloud servers.
- **Solution:** Leveraged Transformers.js and local IndexedDB to run small language models and vector search completely client-side in the browser.
- **Results:** Zero cloud storage costs, zero third-party data transmission, offline-capable.

### Comtranz Global (Fleet Logistics Portal)
- **Role:** Lead Full-Stack Software Engineer
- **Challenge:** Managing multi-driver schedules, vehicle payloads, and financial reconciliations across physical terminals.
- **Solution:** Shipped an administrative portal featuring driver payload manifests, automated transactional SMS notifications, and role-based permissions.

## 4. Services & Engagement Models
1. **Custom Web Applications:** Complete software lifecycle from architecture and database design to frontend implementation and cloud deployment.
2. **Mobility & Logistics Platforms:** Live GPS route calculation, fleet dispatch, dynamic booking engines, and payment settlement.
3. **SaaS Platforms:** Multi-tenant architecture, automated subscription billing, user role permissions, and interactive analytics.
4. **Payment Systems Integration:** Secure payment flows with instant webhook confirmation for Nigerian, African, and international currencies.
5. **System Audits & Modernization:** Codebase refactoring, performance tuning, and transitioning legacy web setups to Next.js.
